description.text: This is a 3-hour Chinese language class from 8:30 to 11:30 every morning Monday to Friday including oral Chinese, Chinese Listening Fundamental Chinese. There is a 2-hour Chinese culture lecture from 14:00 to 16:00 on Tuesday and Thursday. Lectures are about Chinese History and Culture, Chinese Movie Appreciation and Chinese Calligraphy. Weekend Tours a: Juyongguan Great Wall-- Lunch at Jindian Restaurant-- Summer Palace b: Tian'anmen Square -- Forbidden City -- Chinese Acrobat Show c: Enterprise Visit

duration.text: The Summer Course at Beijing Institute of Technology is a 0 N/A long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 486 USD/In total ￥ 3500 CNY/In total

materials.text: Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant High school academic transcript High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Permission from the previous university for tranfer students A student who has studied in China and wants to transfer to another university must provide the permission from original university. Guardian’s Guarantee Only for applicants under 18 years old.

requirements.text: Applicants should be physically healthy and abide by Chinese Laws and university regulations.
